caption: The video captures a long pile of dry brush, branches and debris burning in a grassy field under a grey, overcast sky. The fire is already well established in the first frame and keeps burning through the last, with no ignition or extinguishing shown. Leafless trees stand motionless behind the pile, and the fixed camera keeps the horizon and pile outline in place throughout. Across the pile, orange and yellow flames continuously flicker, rise, collapse and shift in shape and height. A tall flame column near the right-center wanes, then new columns surge up near the center while lower tongues lick the fuel's edges. A plume of pale smoke rises from the left side and drifts upward and left, its density and extent varying as the flames change. Glowing embers stay visible in the lower part of the pile throughout, with small bright spots appearing and dimming. The protruding diagonal stick and the flat board at the right stay in place, so the changes occur in the flames and smoke.
relations: Dry brush and debris fuel the fire, causing flames to continuously flicker, rise, and shift in shape across the pile.
Combustion produces pale smoke from the left side that drifts upward and leftward as flame intensity varies.
Glowing embers persist in the lower pile, with bright spots appearing and dimming as fuel burns.
The diagonal stick and right-side board remain fixed while surrounding flames and smoke change.
